description.zh-CN: 租户管理员角色，拥有该租户的所有权限
description.en-US: Tenant administrator with all permissions for this tenant.

description.zh-CN: 销售岗位：创建和维护报价草稿、上传客户原始资料，并生成面向客户的报价文档。
description.en-US: Customer-facing role: create and maintain quote drafts, upload customer source materials, and generate customer-facing quote documents.

description.zh-CN: 采购岗位：维护寻源、手工价格、成本、证据、工艺点及报价所需的修正 BOM 导入。
description.en-US: Procurement role: maintain sourcing, manual prices, costs, evidence, process points, and corrected BOM imports for QuoteOps.

description.zh-CN: 工程岗:运行 BOM 标准化与转换、查看物料库与规则、上传资料与导入 BOM,并只读查看客户(用于项目客户引用列解析)。数据范围 self(只看自己的 BOM 项目);共享物料库全员可见。
description.en-US: Engineering role: standardize and convert BOMs, view materials and rules, upload files and import BOMs, and view customer references. BOM projects are limited to owned records; the shared material library remains visible to all members.
